description: Search dev board datasheets and product pages. Returns the most relevant passages with their source URL.

configuration.query: FROM cadswarm-boards METADATA _score | WHERE MATCH(content, ?question) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP board_id, title, source_url, text, _score | LIMIT 6

question.description: What to look up, e.g. 'Raspberry Pi Pico mounting hole positions'
